poses: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet extension for four adult female desktop coding companions. Input image 1 is the EXACT existing 4-character sprite design, pose scale, costume palette and illustration style to preserve; input image 2 is the original character design reference only. Create a NEW clean sprite sheet, NOT a poster: exactly FOUR equal columns and FIVE equal rows, exactly twenty separated FULL BODY sprites, no letters, no labels, no borders, no divider lines, no watermark. All bodies entire including every shoe, with generous transparent padding, zero overlap between cells. Columns left to right: LEAD adult woman with short chestnut bob and cream streak, headset, ivory cropped jacket, teal blouse, charcoal pants, green-white sneakers and tablet; CODE adult woman with purple high ponytail, black-purple headphones around neck, purple hoodie, black cropped shirt, black shorts and dark tights, purple-white sneakers and laptop; RESEARCH adult woman with mint-green bob, round dark glasses, cream patterned long cardigan, deep teal dress, dark tights, brown ankle boots and book; REVIEW adult woman with silver bob, black high-neck top, black jacket with orange trim, charcoal cargo pants, heavy black boots, tablet. Preserve original mature adult proportions, faces, hairstyles, outfits, accessories, four palettes and clean outlined pixel-styled anime game art. Same front three-quarter camera angle, same body height and feet baseline within each cell, heads/neck anchored to the same location; no chibi body proportions and no perspective zoom changes. The SAME character repeats down each column. ROW 1: THINKING, free hand gently under chin, slight thoughtful gaze, main held item at waist, face unobscured. ROW 2: WORKING SECOND POSE, lead taps tablet, code types one finger on open laptop held at waist, research follows a line in open book, review studies and points to tablet; small changed arm pose from original working sprite. ROW 3: SUCCESS, warm modest smile and free hand gives clear thumbs-up at shoulder height, other hand holds usual item. ROW 4: WAITING FOR APPROVAL, free hand palm upward at chest height, mildly inquisitive raised brow, usual item held by other hand. ROW 5: ERROR, mildly frustrated concerned face with furrowed brows, free hand on hip, looking at usual item, mouth slightly tense, no injury, face not covered. Do not add floating symbols, sparkles, speech bubbles, decorative effects, furniture or extra objects. Every pose must be useful as a software state. Output tall atlas approximately1024x1920 with strict uniform4x5grid. Background MUST be actual alpha transparency, not a drawn checkerboard or gray scene; no floor, cast shadow or ambient background. Repeat: output a true transparent sprite atlas, twenty full-body figures, all boots in the bottom row fully within the canvas.
transitions: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: exact in-between animation sprite sheet EDIT for a software desktop companion. The attached transparent image is the EDIT TARGET. It has exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows of FULL BODY adult female characters. Preserve its strict grid, exact figure scale, front three-quarter camera, body silhouettes, feet positions, neck anchors, body proportions, costumes, colors, accessories, line style and pixel-style shading. Preserve each character's identity: left chestnut bob/cream streak/ivory jacket/teal shirt, second purple ponytail/headphones/purple hoodie, third mint bob/round glasses/cream long cardigan/teal dress/book, fourth silver bob/black and orange jacket/cargo pants/tablet. Produce exactly twelve full-body sprites, four columns by three rows, retaining generous transparent gutter and every shoe completely on canvas. Very precise local changes only: ROW1 IDLE IN-BETWEEN, same relaxed pose and closed mouth as target first row, shoulders lifted a tiny amount for breathing and only hair tips shifted subtly; no changes to legs or hand pose. ROW2 HALF BLINK, all four characters' eyelids halfway closed (eyes visibly half open, NOT fully shut), mouths closed, same relaxed FIRST ROW body pose. ROW3 HALF SPEECH, all four characters' eyes fully open, mouths slightly parted in a small short vowel shape about HALF the opening of target second-row talking mouths, same relaxed FIRST ROW body pose. These are animation transition frames, NOT alternate character designs. Keep detail edges stable and crisp; do not redraw outfits or choose different poses. Do not add text, labels, borders, objects, symbols, effects or shadows. Output approximately1024x1152. Actual alpha transparency is required, no rendered checkerboard background. If an alpha channel cannot be encoded, use a perfectly flat solid saturated pure magenta #FF00FF backdrop so the sprite edges can be extracted, never checkerboard.
